summary: Checks whether a value is a regular expression.
description: Identified by its internal tag rather than by `instanceof`, so a regular expression from another frame is recognised too.
`isX` and `nonX` answer a question and never interrupt control flow; `requireX` and `requireNonX` hand the value back or throw. The scheme is explained in [](validation-conventions.md).
returns: `true` when the value is a regular expression; otherwise `false`.

examples.title: What passes and what does not
examples.body:
```javascript
isRegExp(/a/); // => true
isRegExp(new RegExp("a")); // => true
isRegExp("/a/"); // => false
isRegExp({}); // => false
isRegExp(null); // => false
```
